item.text: {"basis":"The first sentence obscures the direct relationship between plugins and core functionality with “is based on a modular design where” and “are implemented to provide.” A direct statement preserves modularity and leaves the distinct plugin support rules intact.","decision":"admit","item_id":"093f55b5ddc40cc3","replacement":"containerd is modular, with plugins providing its core functionality.\nPlugins implemented in tree are supported by the containerd community unless explicitly specified as non-stable.\nOut of tree plugins are not supported by the containerd maintainers.","source_sha256":"a314da6f5e9d2e91913e2953b0b3f83cb88edf0864cd856eb5e25d60441938ea","target_end_byte":10594,"target_start_byte":10308}
